purpose: One useful dependency-refresh assessment, followed by a retained complete-delivery capability tested on fresh package bodies.
primary_unit: One fixed consumer revision plus one substantively changed dependency tuple; two package clusters, six adjacent-eligible historical transitions.

sampling.freshness: No selected source/wheel body or outcome accessed before protocol freeze. Historical public releases, possible pretraining exposure, not prospective jobs or actual Alpha adoptions.
sampling.replacement: No outcome-based exclusion or resampling. Failed acquisition or execution remains a charged incomplete mission.

arms.manual: Observed researcher-assisted first-completion workflow constructed in this study, all legitimate helpers/caches retained; one-time assembler parameterization charged; actual manual finalization recorded; not a human-without-AI timing sample.
arms.retained: Existing manual consumer recorder, deterministic paired execution, adopted conventional custody validation, coupled decision/evidence package, unchanged local SUCCESSOR Workbench extension.
arms.conventional: Independent ordinary unittest consumer recorder and package assembler, common environment/meter/verifier/controller/Workbench, equal reuse and resource permissions.

primary_acceptance.preserved: Exact registered source/environment/contract/receipts, every required before and after case valid, complete readable EN/FR decision/evidence/lock diff/replay/cost/limits.
primary_acceptance.regression: Complete baseline-preserved evidence and independently verified target mismatch, exact failing requirement and reproducible next action; accepted assessment may recommend rejection.
primary_acceptance.incomplete: Missing, stale, unexecuted, unsupported, failed setup or incomplete provenance; not accepted useful outcome.
primary_acceptance.customer_acceptance: No inferred external acceptance or paid demand from internal contract acceptance.

resource_policy.model: No runtime model/provider calls inside the fixed workers; researcher/model-assisted discovery and manual finalization unpriced.
resource_policy.caches: All arms may reuse hash-verified source, wheels, environments and eligible baseline evidence with a complete equivalent source/environment/worker/verifier custody chain. New target behavior must execute. Current builders elect fresh before/after probes in parallel; no baseline-cache permission is withheld. An identical complete mission is a no-op.
resource_policy.acquisition: Exactly eight preparation attempts, each enforced max20requests and64MB response allowance plus at most one sentinel byte. Composition bounds entire eight-profile campaign at160requests and513MB. No automatic retry, substitute profile or resampling. Failed setup remains charged incomplete; any later recovery needs a separate disclosed amendment.
resource_policy.no_ops: Same source/contract/tuple is a no-op for workload counting; QA/control/replay runs remain separate charges.

outcome_measures: Accepted complete assessments per six unique missions by arm
Required behavior, source/env/receipt integrity and complete next-action package
Mechanical process wall/CPU and overall request-to-package span separately
Actual researcher actions without invented human minutes
Customer and residual operator effort unknown unless directly observed

causal_claims.incumbent_comparison: Tests automation of observed orchestration/finalization and accepted outcome preservation. No monetary benefit inferred from missing attention or tariff data.
causal_claims.conventional_comparison: Any tie supports adoption of competent conventional methods, not algorithmic or transformational-method superiority. Shared conventional validator adoption is explicit.
nonclaims: No independent defect-family count from repeated cases/releases

ablations_and_controls.source_only_prior: Historical coverage-gap reference from preservedv1; not a cheap equivalent accepted comparator.
ablations_and_controls.evidence_binding: Preserved candidate01 vs corrected custody controls isolate missing binding checks; synthetic, no primary job/defect counts.
ablations_and_controls.negative_result: Real verifier exit2 on explicitly altered synthetic observation tests rejection-assessment path; not upstream incident.
ablations_and_controls.no_change: Repeated unchanged registered input is evaluated only as no-op/control, never extra output.

analysis.quality: Report all six pairings and both clusters, exact counts and every failure. No p-values or generalized reliability rate from sixhistoricalmissions.
analysis.timing: One observed run per arm/mission, same limits; report descriptive paired values. No timingprecisionclaim onsharedhost or unsupportedhumanminutecomparison.
analysis.money: Complete marginal, recurring and fully loaded cost remain null where billing, inference, maintenance or utilization missing. Known quantities plus unknowns.
analysis.pricing: Sourced wage/procurement context plus symbolic break-even thresholds; no chosen market price or invented matched duration.
analysis.repayment: Same testedasset investment including unsuccessfulB01, common and conventional construction, verification/integration and upkeep. No customer savings reclassified as provider receipts.
analysis.financeability: Actualcollections0, startingcapital/allocation/obligations/reserves unknown; no financednextasset or dollarvaluation.

admission_rule.engineering: Use a builder only if every selected available mission yields a complete correct packet or a substantiated failure under the fixed contract, and all mandatory custody/refusal controls pass. Report primary incomplete outcomes; do not waive them. If bothbuilders tie on acceptedquality, retain strong conventional components with explicitresource tradeoffs ratherthanclaimmethodsuperiority.
admission_rule.economic: Do not claim repayment or approve financeable expansion without supported complete incremental costs, volume and benefit. Preserveunknowns andidentify smallesttargetedinternalmeasurement.
admission_rule.scope: Research reusable tool only; native Workbench admission HOLD and absent active authority unchanged.

public_freeze: Issue4850comment with exactprotocol/source manifest hash beforeany selectedbody acquisition.
manual_finalization: Root reads armA own verifications and supplies supported disposition to charged parameterized first-delivery assembler; all tool/researcher actions and full span recorded. Cross-arm outcomes may be visible according to balanced order; no blinded human accuracy claim.
